task: Kayla has emailed me pictures of all trips we had together over the years. Which trip location has the most pictures?

emails.subject: Trip Again?
emails.body:
Hey,
It's been a while since we went on a trip together. I am free end of next month.
How is your schedule looking?
Best,
Kayla

emails.subject: Re: Trip Again?
emails.body: I am free too. Let's plan something!

emails.subject: Re: Re: Trip Again?
emails.body: Awesome. I'll start looking for places.

emails.subject: Compilation of our Pics
emails.body:
Hey,
I have collected all the pics we have taken together over the years.
Hope you like them!

emails.subject: Re: Compilation of our Pics
emails.body: That's fantastic! Thank you so much!!
